looks.bm: Ianya seperti nanah yang mempunyai cecair yang berwarna kuning jika dipicit
looks.en: Small pocket of pus caused by bacteria infecting your tooth or gums

todo.bm: Perlu pergi ke Klinik Pergigian dengan kadar segera kerana ianya boleh menjadi lebih teruk jika dibiarkan walau sehari
todo.en: Please visit the nearest dental clinic for further assessment and treatment, as the condition may worsen over time

looks.bm: Benjolan kecil yang berisi cecair air liur (saliva) yang terbentuk di dalam mulut
looks.en: Small, fluid-filled swelling or bubble that develops inside the mouth

todo.bm: Sila berjumpa dengan doktor gigi untuk pemeriksaan dan rawatan lanjut sekiranya benjolan ini tidak hilang atau semakin membesar
todo.en: Please visit your dentist for further assessment

looks.bm: MIH ialah keadaan di mana enamel (lapisan luar gigi yang melindungi gigi) tidak terbentuk dengan sempurna
looks.en: MIH is a condition where the enamel (outer protective layer of the tooth) does not develop properly

todo.bm: Sila bawa anak anda ke klinik pergigian berhampiran untuk pemeriksaan. Rawatan awal dapat membantu melindungi enamel gigi yang lemah dan mengelakkan kerosakan menjadi lebih teruk
todo.en: Please bring your child to the nearest dental clinic for an assessment. Early treatment can help protect the weak enamel and prevent further damage

looks.bm: PHGS ialah jangkitan virus di dalam mulut yang disebabkan oleh Herpes Simplex Virus (HSV), biasanya HSV-1
looks.en: PHGS is a viral infection in the mouth caused by the Herpes Simplex Virus (HSV), usually HSV-1

todo.bm:
1) Drink plenty of water – Prevent dehydration.
2) Take painkillers – Paracetamol or ibuprofen (according to the child's age and weight).
3) Eat soft foods – Porridge, yoghurt and mashed potatoes.
4)Avoid spicy, sour and hot foods – They can irritate the ulcers.
5) Maintain oral hygiene – Clean the mouth gently.
5) Apply petroleum jelly – If there are sores on the lips.
6) Visit a dentist or doctor – For assessment, especially if the child has difficulty eating or drinking.
